edits.new: 10. Smoke check: the embedded Drools kit evaluates the seeded rule packages against the generated cases and records one decision record per evaluation through the decision-record library (DP-03, DP-04). Each record uses the envelope of RWB-PLT-E1027-CON. A record for a case creation takes the code and payload of RWB-P3-E1018-APP: decision code "D6", final call "CASE_CREATED", the ENTRY rule ID, the package version and the ALS business date. A record for an exclusion carries the exclusion rule ID and package version; its decision code is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2252). The actor, and the code and payload of any other evaluation, are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2252). The codes are confirmed at the decision-record contract review; the seed and its criteria do not change if they differ.
